attacks.claim: Dark mode is broken: `.day-card` hardcodes `background: #ffffff` while text color uses `--text`, which becomes near-white (#f2f2f7) in dark mode. Tile titles and `.meta` (--muted #a1a1a6) render light-on-white, so the main content is illegible for ~30% of users.

QA covered only light mode (Chrome 1440 light, Safari iPhone 14 light). Dark mode was never tested, which is how the contrast bug got through. Lighthouse accessibility 100 was evidently measured in light mode too.

The most frequent planner action (add recipe to shopping list, 9.4/week per WAU, 64% on mobile) goes from one tap to a five-step flow (tile → recipe page → Ingredients tab → servings sheet → Add to list). The brief's own data contradicts removing the button for decluttering. It will likely hurt the key metric being watched.
attacks.evidence: "The old tile-level \"+ List\" button is removed to declutter tiles." vs "Most frequent planner action: ... 9.4 times/week"

attacks.claim: The mobile fixed bottom bar (72px) overlays content, and `.planner` has no bottom padding or scroll-margin. On mobile the last day (Sunday) and its tile buttons will be hidden behind the bar and unreachable or obscured. The markup notes that Sunday is the last child of `.planner`, which makes this concrete.
attacks.evidence: `.action-bar { position: fixed; ... bottom: 0; height: 72px; }` and `.planner { ... padding: 16px; }`; "Sunday is the last child of .planner"

attacks.claim: Tile images have empty alt (acceptable if decorative), but the Swap button's accessible name is just "Swap" for every tile, which is ambiguous for screen readers. The `<nav class="action-bar">` has no label and contains actions rather than navigation. Neither is blocking.
Rollback by flag flip is sound, but there are no numeric thresholds or owner for the watched metrics, and no staged rollout. 100% on day one with no canary means problems hit everyone at once.
attacks.evidence: "Ship to 100% Tue 10:00 PT behind `planner_v7`"; "Watch: planner page JS errors, shopping-list additions/WAU, planner bounce rate."
